Content: EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK Welcome to Our Company Effective Date: January 2025 ======================================== WELCOME MESSAGE ======================================== Welcome to our team! This handbook provides important information about company policies, benefits, and expectations. Please read it carefully and keep it for future reference. Our mission is to create a safe, productive, and respectful workplace where every employee can thrive. ======================================== TABLE OF CONTENTS ======================================== 1. Employment Basics 2. Time Off and Leave Policies 3. Work Schedule and Attendance 4. Compensation and Benefits 5. Workplace Conduct 6. Safety and Security 7. Employee Development ======================================== 1. EMPLOYMENT BASICS ======================================== EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION Full-Time Employees: - Work 40 hours per week - Eligible for all benefits - Receive paid time off - Health insurance coverage Part-Time Employees: - Work less than 30 hours per week - Limited benefits eligibility - Prorated time off benefits - No health insurance Temporary/Seasonal: - Fixed-term employment - Not eligible for benefits - May be converted to regular status PROBATIONARY PERIOD - All new employees: 90-day probationary period - Performance reviewed at 30, 60, and 90 days - Full benefits begin after probation - Employment may be terminated during probation ======================================== 2. TIME OFF AND LEAVE POLICIES ======================================== PAID TIME OFF (PTO) Full-Time Employees: - Years 0-2: 15 days per year - Years 3-5: 20 days per year - Years 6-10: 25 days per year - Years 10+: 30 days per year Part-Time Employees: - 10 days per year (prorated) PTO ACCRUAL: - Accrues each pay period - Maximum rollover: 40 hours per year - Must be used within 12 months - Cannot be cashed out except at termination PTO REQUEST PROCESS: 1. Submit request in employee portal 2. Minimum 2 weeks notice for 3+ days off 3. Supervisor approval required 4. Holiday blackout periods apply 5. First-come, first-served for peak periods SICK LEAVE Full-Time Employees: - 10 sick days per year - Does not roll over - Medical documentation required for 3+ consecutive days - May use for family member illness Part-Time Employees: - 5 sick days per year (prorated) HOLIDAYS Paid Holidays (Full-Time Only): - New Year's Day - Martin Luther King Jr. Day - Memorial Day - Independence Day - Labor Day - Thanksgiving Day - Day after Thanksgiving - Christmas Eve (half day) - Christmas Day - New Year's Eve (half day) Total: 10 paid holidays Holiday pay: Regular hourly rate × 8 hours PARENTAL LEAVE - 12 weeks paid leave (primary caregiver) - 6 weeks paid leave (secondary caregiver) - Additional 12 weeks unpaid FMLA available - Must be employed 12+ months - Return-to-work guarantee BEREAVEMENT LEAVE - 5 days paid leave (immediate family) - 3 days paid leave (extended family) - Additional unpaid time may be approved JURY DUTY - Paid leave for jury service - Submit jury summons to HR - Return to work if dismissed early MILITARY LEAVE - Unpaid leave for military service - Job protection per USERRA - Benefits continuation available ======================================== 3. WORK SCHEDULE AND ATTENDANCE ======================================== STANDARD HOURS Full-Time: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Monday - Friday) - 1-hour unpaid lunch break - Two 15-minute paid breaks Shift Work: - First Shift: 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM - Second Shift: 2:30 PM - 11:00 PM - Third Shift: 11:00 PM - 7:30 AM - Shift differential: $2/hour (2nd shift), $3/hour (3rd shift) ATTENDANCE POLICY - Punctuality is essential - Clock in/out required for hourly employees - Notify supervisor if late (before shift start) - More than 3 unexcused absences = written warning TARDINESS: - Late: Arrival after scheduled start time - 3 tardies = 1 unexcused absence - Excessive tardiness = disciplinary action ATTENDANCE POINTS SYSTEM: - Unexcused absence: 1 point - Tardy (under 2 hours): 0.5 points - No-call/no-show: 3 points - 8 points in 12 months: Termination OVERTIME - Requires supervisor pre-approval - Paid at 1.5× regular rate (over 40 hours/week) - Mandatory overtime may be required - Refusal of mandatory overtime = disciplinary action REMOTE WORK POLICY Eligible Positions Only: - Requires manager approval - Hybrid schedule: 3 days office, 2 days remote - Must maintain productivity standards - Equipment provided by company - Home office must meet safety requirements ======================================== 4. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS ======================================== PAYROLL - Pay periods: Bi-weekly (every other Friday) - Direct deposit required - Pay stubs available in employee portal - Year-end W-2 forms available by January 31 HEALTH INSURANCE Full-Time Employees (after probation): Medical Insurance: - Company pays 80% of premium - Employee pays 20% - Coverage effective 1st of month after hire - HSA-eligible plan available - Annual open enrollment in November Dental Insurance: - Company pays 50% of premium - Coverage for employee and dependents -

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS ======================================== PAYROLL - Pay periods: Bi-weekly (every other Friday) - Direct deposit required - Pay stubs available in employee portal - Year-end W-2 forms available by January 31 HEALTH INSURANCE Full-Time Employees (after probation): Medical Insurance: - Company pays 80% of premium - Employee pays 20% - Coverage effective 1st of month after hire - HSA-eligible plan available - Annual open enrollment in November Dental Insurance: - Company pays 50% of premium - Coverage for employee and dependents - Preventive care covered 100% Vision Insurance: - $10/month employee contribution - Annual eye exam covered - Discounts on glasses/contacts RETIREMENT PLAN 401(k) Retirement Savings: - Eligible after 6 months - Company match: 50% up to 6% contribution - Vesting: Immediate for employee contributions - Company match vests after 3 years - Financial planning services available LIFE INSURANCE - Company-paid: 1× annual salary - Additional coverage available at employee cost - Accidental Death & Dismemberment included DISABILITY INSURANCE - Short-term: 60% salary up to 12 weeks - Long-term: 60% salary after 90 days - Waiting period: 14 days EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (EAP) - Free confidential counseling (8 sessions/year) - Legal consultation - Financial planning assistance - Family support services - 24/7 hotline: 1-800-EAP-HELP ADDITIONAL BENEFITS - Gym membership reimbursement: $50/month - Professional development: $1,000/year - Tuition reimbursement: Up to $5,250/year - Employee referral bonus: $1,000 - Service awards (5, 10, 15, 20, 25 years) ======================================== 5. WORKPLACE CONDUCT ======================================== CODE OF CONDUCT All employees must: - Treat others with respect - Follow all safety procedures - Protect company property - Maintain confidentiality - Report ethical concerns - Avoid conflicts of interest DRESS CODE Business Casual: - Collared shirts or blouses - Slacks, khakis, or professional skirts - Closed-toe shoes - Clean, professional appearance Safety Areas (Warehouse/Production): - Steel-toed boots required - Long pants (no shorts) - Safety glasses in designated areas - High-visibility vest required - Hair tied back, no jewelry Casual Friday: - Jeans allowed - Company logo shirts acceptable - No torn or excessively worn clothing PROHIBITED: - Tank tops, shorts (office areas) - Flip-flops, sandals (safety areas) - Offensive graphics or language - Excessively casual attire ANTI-HARASSMENT POLICY Zero tolerance for: - Sexual harassment - Discrimination - Bullying or intimidation - Retaliation REPORTING PROCEDURE: 1. Report to supervisor or HR immediately 2. Investigation conducted within 5 business days 3. Confidentiality maintained 4. No retaliation against complainants 5. Disciplinary action up to termination SUBSTANCE ABUSE POLICY Prohibited: - Alcohol consumption during work hours - Illegal drug use - Working under the influence - Possession of controlled substances Drug Testing: - Pre-employment screening - Random testing (safety-sensitive positions) - Post-accident testing - Reasonable suspicion testing Violation = Immediate termination CONFIDENTIALITY Employees must protect: - Customer information - Financial data - Trade secrets - Employee personal information - Proprietary processes Breach of confidentiality = Immediate termination ======================================== 6. SAFETY AND SECURITY ======================================== WORKPLACE SAFETY - Report all hazards immediately - Use required PPE in designated areas - Follow all safety procedures - Report injuries within 24 hours - Complete annual safety training EMERGENCY PROCEDURES Fire: 1. Activate fire alarm 2. Evacuate building 3. Meet at designated assembly point 4. Do not re-enter until authorized Medical Emergency: 1. Call 911 2. Notify first aid team 3. Render aid if trained 4. Complete incident report WORKERS' COMPENSATION - Report injuries immediately to supervisor - Medical treatment at designated facilities - Complete incident report within 24 hours - Light duty available during recovery - Protected from retaliation SECURITY - Employee ID badge required at all times - Sign in visitors - Lock workstations when away - Report suspicious activity - No unauthorized facility access ======================================== 7. EMPLOYEE DEVELOPMENT ======================================== PERFORMANCE REVIEWS - Annual review for all employees - Mid-year check-in meetings - Based on SMART goals - Merit increases based on performance - Promotion opportunities discussed TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES - New hire orientation (1 week) - Department-specific training - Safety certifications - Leadership development programs - Technical skills training TUITION REIMBURSEMENT Eligible Expenses: - Undergraduate/graduate courses - Professional certifications - Job-related training Requirements: - Pre-approval required - Grade of C or better - Remain employed 12 months after completion - Maximum $5,250 per year CAREER ADVANCEMENT - Internal job postings - Mentorship program available - Cross-training opportunities - Succession planning - Promotion from within policy ======================================== ACKNOWLEDGMENT ======================================== I acknowledge that I have received and read the Employee Handbook.
